summary: npm package ships only an obfuscated fake Cloudflare Turnstile redirect page
details: Package contains a single index.html declared as `main`, which is a Cloudflare-branded 'Just a moment...' clone embedding a Turnstile widget and heavily obfuscated JavaScript (obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` identifiers, shuffled string array, control-flow flattening) that assembles a redirect URL at runtime and assigns it to `window.location`, forwarding the current query string. There are no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare lifecycle scripts, and `main` points to HTML that Node cannot require or import, so installing or requiring this package does not execute code on a developer machine or build system. The behavior only affects a browser that loads this file via a CDN mirror (unpkg/jsdelivr), consistent with abuse of the npm registry as free CDN hosting for a phishing/redirect landing page rather than an attack on the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
